Looking for paragliding near Marmaris? The world's best tandem flight is just 2.5 hours away in Ölüdeniz. Here's the complete cost breakdown for Marmaris to Ölüdeniz paragliding.

Is There Paragliding in Marmaris?

Marmaris itself does not have a commercial paragliding launch site. The mountains around Marmaris lack the consistent thermals and vertical drop needed for safe tandem flights. However, you're just a 2.5-hour drive from Ölüdeniz — home to the world's most famous Babadağ Mountain paragliding experience.

Thousands of tourists from Marmaris make this day trip every season. It's one of the most popular excursions from the Marmaris resort area, and we make it seamless.

Marmaris to Ölüdeniz: How to Get There

  • Our Day Trip Package ($250): Private transfer picks you up from your Marmaris hotel at 07:00, flight in Ölüdeniz at 10:00, back in Marmaris by 15:00. Lunch time at the Blue Lagoon included.
  • Self-Drive: Rent a car and drive the D400 highway. The journey passes through Göcek and Fethiye — stunning coastal road. Free parking at our Ölüdeniz office.
  • Dolmuş (Minibus): Regular services from Marmaris bus station to Fethiye (₺200, ~3h). From Fethiye, catch a dolmuş to Ölüdeniz (₺30, 20min). We pick you up from Ölüdeniz center.

Why Come to Ölüdeniz from Marmaris for Paragliding?

Ölüdeniz is the #1 paragliding site in the world for good reason:

  • 🏔️ 1,960m launch altitude (most sites are 800-1,200m)
  • 🌊 Landing on Belcekiz Beach — world-famous Blue Lagoon below you
  • ⏱️ 25-45 minute flights (vs. 10-15 min at cheaper sites)
  • 🛡️ THK regulated — strictest safety standards in Turkey. See our safety details.
